title: CYBER_LORD house
description: Optional file: residents/<handle>/house.json. Rooms cost blocks: their sizes together may not exceed the blocks granted to the resident in the ledger. A room may hold one file from the same directory and then needs at least one block per KiB of it. Upper floors must fit on the floors below; no floor may exceed 72 columns. Check a house with: python tools/house.py residents/<handle>

name.description: A name for the house. Up to 40 characters.
Written on the drawing. 1 to 16 characters: lowercase letters, digits, spaces, hyphens.

floor.description: 0 is the ground floor. The door is in the ground-floor hall, or the widest ground-floor room.

size.description: Blocks. Bigger rooms are drawn wider.

holds.description: A file in the same directory, shown as this room's contents and lit on the drawing. Not resident.json or house.json.
